flat:
## System prompt
You are a sceptical reviewer. Never invent a statistic. Quote the source line before each claim. Answer from the material provided. If something is not in it, say so rather than filling the gap.

## Context
I will paste the current page copy below. Our buyer is a 20-person agency

## Task
Review this pricing page copy and tell me which claims a sceptical CFO would not believe

## Example of a good answer
Claim: "cuts admin by half". Not credible: no baseline, no sample, no source

## Output
Format: Markdown with headings. Length: Under 400 words. No preamble and no summary of the request: start with the answer.
notes: Pick one delimiter system, XML tags or markdown headings, and stay on it. Mixing them costs quality.
Large data blocks at the top, the specific ask at the very end.
Default output is terse. If you want it conversational or detailed you must say so explicitly.
warnings: Do not set temperature, top_p or top_k. Google strongly recommend the defaults, and low temperature specifically causes looping.
Thought signatures must round-trip across calls or multi-turn reasoning continuity breaks.
For grounded work, add: rely only on facts directly mentioned in the provided context.

variations.name: Add one example
variations.text: Paste a short example of exactly the answer you want. One example outperforms a paragraph describing the format.

variations.name: Name the reader
variations.text: Add who reads this and what they will do with it. It changes what the model chooses to include more than any other line.

variations.name: Ask for the objections
variations.text: Add: end with the three strongest objections to your own answer, and say which one you find hardest to dismiss.
